title: Figure 15: relativistic rocket calculator spreadsheet for sample Alpha Centauri mission
description: Screenshot of a "Relativistic Rocket Calculator" spreadsheet with input sections (payload mass, specific impulse, distance to star, maximum acceleration) and computed outputs (mission time, velocity at midpoint, energy and fuel required), highlighted in yellow. Two embedded charts show "Maximum Velocity as a Function of Fuel Consumption" and "Acceleration and Rocket Time versus Earth Time." Captioned "Figure 15. Spreadsheet for Sample Mission to Alpha Centauri," relating to a Bussard aneutronic propulsion system scenario.
